from solution import merge_sorted_list


def test_issue_example_from_description():
    """Merge multiple sorted inputs into a single sorted iterator."""
    result = list(merge_sorted_list([25, 24, 15, 4, 5, 29, 110], [19, 20, 11, 56, 25, 233, 154], [24, 26, 54, 48]))
    expected = [4, 5, 11, 15, 19, 20, 24, 24, 25, 25, 26, 29, 48, 54, 56, 110, 154, 233]  # hand-sorted 7+7+4=18 items from issue
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_all_empty():
    """Merge multiple sorted inputs into a single sorted iterator."""
    result = list(merge_sorted_list([], [], []))
    expected = []  # 0+0+0=0 items
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_only_first_list_nonempty():
    """Merge multiple sorted inputs into a single sorted iterator."""
    result = list(merge_sorted_list([3, 1, 2], [], []))
    expected = [1, 2, 3]  # sorted([3,1,2]) = [1,2,3]; 3+0+0=3 items
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_already_sorted():
    """Merge multiple sorted inputs into a single sorted iterator."""
    result = list(merge_sorted_list([1, 4, 7], [2, 5, 8], [3, 6, 9]))
    expected = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]  # merge 1..9 in order; 3+3+3=9 items
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_reverse_sorted():
    """Merge multiple sorted inputs into a single sorted iterator."""
    result = list(merge_sorted_list([3, 2, 1], [6, 5, 4], [9, 8, 7]))
    expected = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]  # sorted 3+3+3=9 items 1..9
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_duplicates_across_lists():
    """Merge multiple sorted inputs into a single sorted iterator."""
    result = list(merge_sorted_list([5, 5, 5], [5, 5], [5]))
    expected = [5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5]  # 3+2+1=6 copies of 5
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_negative_and_zero():
    """Merge multiple sorted inputs into a single sorted iterator."""
    result = list(merge_sorted_list([-5, 10, -1], [0, -10, 5], [3, -3, 0]))
    expected = [-10, -5, -3, -1, 0, 0, 3, 5, 10]  # sorted(-5,10,-1,0,-10,5,3,-3,0); 3+3+3=9 items
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_single_element_each():
    """Merge multiple sorted inputs into a single sorted iterator."""
    result = list(merge_sorted_list([42], [7], [19]))
    expected = [7, 19, 42]  # sorted(42,7,19) = [7,19,42]; 1+1+1=3 items
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_unequal_lengths_unsorted():
    """Merge multiple sorted inputs into a single sorted iterator."""
    result = list(merge_sorted_list([100], [1, 50], [25, 75, 125, 0]))
    expected = [0, 1, 25, 50, 75, 100, 125]  # sorted(100,1,50,25,75,125,0); 1+2+4=7 items
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_output_is_sorted():
    """Result is a single sorted iterator in ascending order."""
    result = list(merge_sorted_list([10, 2], [9, 3], [8, 1]))
    expected = [1, 2, 3, 8, 9, 10]  # sorted(10,2,9,3,8,1); 2+2+2=6 items
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_output_length_is_sum():
    """Single iterator holds all inputs with length equal to sum of lengths."""
    result = list(merge_sorted_list([1, 2], [3], [4, 5, 6]))
    expected = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]  # 2+1+3=6 items
    assert len(result) == 6  # 2+1+3=6
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_output_contains_all_inputs():
    """Merge multiple inputs into a single iterator containing every element."""
    result = list(merge_sorted_list([1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6], [7, 8, 9]))
    expected = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]  # 3+3+3=9 items 1..9
    assert result == expected
